# MLB.com

> The official home of Major League Baseball featuring live scores, game coverage, news, player transactions, and exclusive streaming content.

MLB.com provides comprehensive baseball coverage across all 30 MLB teams, minor league prospects, international competitions, and related sports. The site combines real-time game data, breaking news, player injury reports, and premium streaming access through MLB.TV.

## Key Topics

- Live Scores & Game Results
- MLB Teams
- Player Transactions & Roster Moves
- Injury Reports
- Minor League Baseball & Prospects
- Statcast Analytics
- Spring Training
- Postseason & Playoffs
- World Baseball Classic
- MLB.TV Streaming
- Starting Lineups
- Player Rankings
- Breaking News & Rumors
- Podcasts
- Opening Day

## Live Game Coverage & Scores

- [MLB.com | The Official Site of Major League Baseball](https://www.mlb.com): MLB homepage with live scores, schedules, and exclusive baseball coverage
- [MLB Starting Lineups Today | MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/starting-lineups): Daily MLB starting lineups with game schedules and live scores
- [MLB News: Scores, Standings, Stats, Trades, Rumors](https://www.mlb.com/news): Official MLB news source covering scores, standings, trades, and player updates

## Player Information & Roster Management

- [Transactions | MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/transactions): MLB player transactions, roster moves, and team assignment logs
- [MLB Injury Report 2025: Fractures, Strains, Tommy John, and more](https://www.mlb.com/injury-report): Current MLB player injury status and recovery updates by team

## Analytics & Advanced Statistics

- [Statcast Videos | MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/video/topic/statcast): Statcast analytics videos with highlights and pitch velocity data

## Minor Leagues & Player Development

- [MLB Pipeline | Minor League Baseball](https://www.mlb.com/pipeline): MLB Pipeline prospect rankings, news, and minor league coverage

## International & Special Events

- [World Baseball Classic | MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/world-baseball-classic): Official World Baseball Classic tournament coverage and results
- [Athletes Unlimited Softball League | MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/ausl): Athletes Unlimited Softball League rosters, schedule, and news

## Streaming & Multimedia Content

- [MLB.TV Out-of-Market Packages | Buy MLB.TV | MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/live-stream-games/subscribe): MLB.TV streaming subscription packages and out-of-market game access
- [MLB Podcasts: Morning Lineup, Pipeline, and more | MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/fans/podcasts): MLB podcast directory including Morning Lineup and Pipeline shows

## Historical & Reference

- [Postseason History | MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/postseason/history): MLB playoff history, year-by-year recaps, and historical records
